preconditions.description: The number of photos on the widget is between 3 and 1000, inclusive.
The number of albums is between 1 and 40, inclusive.
Each album contains between 1 and 1000 photos, inclusive.

postconditions.expression: output == -1 or (len(output) == n and all(output[i] != output[i+1] for i in range(n-1)) and all(output[i] in albums for i in range(n) and output[i] in albums for i in range(n)))
postconditions.description: The output is either -1 if no solution exists, or a list of n album numbers such that no two consecutive numbers are from the same album.
